title: RegVelo 潜空间实验室
scope: 默认 normal 潜变量配置；近似后验为对角高斯。

training_demo.encoder: linear mean/variance heads, spliced then unspliced, input divided by 2
training_demo.dynamics: two-gene Softplus GRN, per-gene terminal times, differentiable 6-step RK4
training_demo.likelihood: independent Gaussian with fixed standard deviation 0.18
training_demo.objective: average reconstruction NLL plus weighted diagonal-Gaussian KL
training_demo.not_equivalent_to: full RegVelo, original solver, complete penalty terms, preprocessing or fitted biological results

posterior_demo: analytically tractable one-dimensional linear Gaussian model; exact posterior here is not the exact RegVelo posterior
privacy: No real data uploaded. Calculations run in browser memory. Reload resets training.
